basic_profile.bio: CuriousMewSeeker is a 27-year-old software developer from Krakow, Poland, with a keen interest in health and fitness. They are particularly fascinated by orthotropics and the principles of facial development. In their free time, they enjoy delving into Eastern philosophy and playing mobile strategy games like Immortal Taoist. They are single and typically browse Reddit during the evenings after work. They also have a side interest in personal finance, particularly investing in emerging markets, as evidenced by their recent activity in subreddits like IndiaInvestments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: While not formally educated in dentistry or orthodontics, CuriousMewSeeker has developed a strong foundational understanding of orthotropics through self-teaching, primarily by consuming online content from experts like Dr. Mike Mew. They apply this knowledge personally and discuss it with others in niche communities.
